x_query.oql:
works where date >= (2019-01-01)
  and date <= (2026-08-16)
  and title/abstract has (
    (
      ChatGPT
      or LLM
      or LLMs
      or stemmed "AI agent"
      or stemmed "AI-assisted"
      or stemmed "AI-augmented"
      or stemmed "large language model"
    )
    and (
      stemmed "AI-augmented engineering"
      or stemmed "software delivery"
      or stemmed "software development life cycle"
      or stemmed "software development lifecycle"
      or stemmed "software engineering lifecycle"
    )
    and (
      stemmed "error rate"
      or stemmed "human approval"
      or stemmed "productivity-quality paradox"
      or stemmed "team-level"
      or coordination
      or orchestration
      or workflow
    )
    and (developer or human or team or trust)
  )
